review_candidates.title: Senior IT Infrastructure & Systems Support Specialist (Singapore)
review_candidates.description: We are seeking a highly versatile Senior IT Infrastructure & Systems Support Specialist to oversee systems administration, high-performance compute environments, local data center operations, network security, and end-user technical support. This role bridges advanced server and systems administration—including Linux/Windows Server OS provisioning, system patching, Active Directory/IAM, and NVIDIA GPU AI nodes—with hands-on technical support for both deep-tech power users and general staff. The ideal candidate will manage data center physical safety, system backup/recovery, infrastructure lifecycles, procurement, vendor servicing, and endpoint security. Key Responsibilities Data Center & AI Infrastructure Operations Administer, configure, and maintain Linux, Windows Server, and NVIDIA GPU/AI compute nodes, including OS deployment, kernel & cluster updates, system patching, hypervisor management, and performance tuning. Oversee data center physical safety, rack setup, power/cooling distribution, cabling, and scheduled preventative servicing. Execute system administration tasks for backup, disaster recovery, server health monitoring, and storage capacity planning. Networking & Security Management Administer local network infrastructure, firewalls, office Wi-Fi networks, subnets, and network security protocols. Manage Identity and Access Management (IAM), Active Directory/LDAP systems, and access controls in accordance with least-privilege principles. Implement and enforce physical security controls, system vulnerability management, patch enforcement, data loss prevention (DLP), and endpoint defense solutions. Office IT & User Support Serve as primary system administrator and technical support engineer for infrastructure users, developers, and general end users. Perform system administration across Google Workspace and core SaaS applications, managing automated user provisioning and settings. Administer MDM tools (especially Jamf) to deploy, patch, configure, and secure macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints. Maintain office IT equipment, including AV systems, Zoom Room setups, and copiers. Coordinate IT logistics for company presentations, internal events, and seamless new-hire onboarding setups. Essential Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Technology, or a related field. 5+ years of combined experience in system administration, IT infrastructure management, data center operations, and user support. Hands-on system administration expertise across Linux (Ubuntu), Windows Server, and NVIDIA server environments. Strong expertise in network administration, VPN, Wi-Fi, firewalls, and access control. Proven track record in vendor management, hardware procurement, system backups, and servicing schedules. Excellent troubleshooting skills and clear communication with both technical power users and non-technical staff. Available to start work immediately. Desirable Requirements Certifications in systems or network administration (e.g., MCSA, CCNA, or NVIDIA hardware systems). Proficiency with shell scripting (Bash, PowerShell, Python) for system automation and administrative tasks. Experience working in high-performance computing (HPC) or deep-tech research environments. Strong documentation skills for IT operational procedures, system SOPs, and disaster recovery plans. About The Company At Horizon Quantum, our mission is to unlock broad quantum advantage by building the software infrastructure that empowers developers to use quantum computing to solve the world’s toughest computational problems. We're bridging the gap between today’s quantum hardware and tomorrow’s applications through the creation of advanced software development tools. Triple Alpha, our integrated development environment, enables developers to write sophisticated, hardware-agnostic quantum programs at multiple levels of abstraction. Learn more at www.horizonquantum.com.

review_candidates.description: Pay: $75,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year Why This Is a Great Opportunity Own meaningful infrastructure projects across networking, systems, security, identity, and Microsoft 365 in a sophisticated multi-office environment. Join a collaborative IT team where your technical expertise directly improves how people work every day. Get hands-on exposure to Cisco, Aruba, Ruckus, Juniper, Meraki, Fortinet, and Palo Alto environments. Administer Active Directory, Entra ID, Group Policy, user accounts, permissions, and role-based access. Support Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive. Troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN, wireless, endpoint, and connectivity issues. Provide occasional escalated end-user support and help resolve complex technical issues. Manage endpoint patching across desktops, laptops, and mobile devices. Maintain print servers and enterprise printing environments. Experience supporting print servers and enterprise printing environments. Excellent communication skills and the ability to support non-technical users. Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred. Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, Microsoft SC-200, MD-102, Palo Alto PCNSE, or related credentials are preferred. Palo Alto Networks experience is preferred. Why You Will Love Working Here You will have the opportunity to make a visible impact, work with modern infrastructure and security technologies, and take ownership of projects that improve the organization as a whole. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, professional growth, and people who enjoy solving problems rather than simply putting out fires. If you want a role where your technical skills are trusted and your ideas can make a difference, we would love to hear from you. review_candidates.title: System Administrator (Infrastructure & Global Support) (m/f/d)
review_candidates.description: NOW HIRING FULL-TIME SZCZECIN System Administrator (Infrastructure & Global Support) Keep the infrastructure running for teams across the whole group, from a base at our Szczecin site. Networks, systems, and whatever the day brings. Szczecin Full-time 9.000 - 12.000 PLN gross/month Start: asap Do you like variety, and do you go and figure things out rather than wait to be told? We are looking for a System Administrator to support our infrastructure and our people across the group, from our Szczecin site. One hour it is a switch config, the next a request from a colleague three time zones away. About TCG In 2004, our founders flew to China for the Canton Fair. No plan B, no investors. The Customization Group is now a global leader in mass customization and print-on-demand e-commerce, manufacturing personalised products in Germany, Poland, the USA and Latvia and selling through 20+ own shops and 1,000+ partner stores. 750+ people, 40+ nationalities. The Role The job is global: you help keep our on-premise infrastructure running for colleagues across our locations. Two things sit at the heart of it, networking and systems administration , and you move between them and everything around them rather than owning one narrow lane. Some days that is the network, some days it is Microsoft 365 or a Windows Server, some days it is a colleague who needs a hand. It is broad, hands-on, and rarely the same two days running. You do not need to know all of it on day one; you need the foundation and the drive to grow into the rest, which is exactly how the person before you did it. This is an on-site role: the hardware and the team are here in Szczecin, so it is not remote or hybrid. In short: Networking and systems administration, on-premise first, supporting a global team from Szczecin. Broad, hands-on, and rarely the same two days running. What You Will Do → Look after the network. Our multi-site setup runs on MikroTik and HPE/Aruba, with VLANs and VPN tying the locations together. You keep it healthy and help it grow. → Administer our systems. Microsoft 365 (Entra ID, Exchange, Intune) and on-prem Windows Server, plus the accounts, devices and access that colleagues rely on every day. → Support people across our sites. Be the person colleagues can bring a problem to, wherever they sit, and sort out the office networks and hardware they depend on. → Troubleshoot to the root cause. When something breaks, find why, fix it, and write it down so it does not come back. Keeping things secure is part of the job throughout. → Make things easier with automation. We are an AI-first company that builds its own internal tools, so there is real room to automate the repetitive work, wiring up AI-driven workflows and connectors with tools like Zapier, n8n and MCP. A genuine plus, not a day-one must. Who We're Looking For Sounds like you? → 2+ years in a systems administration, network administration, IT support or network operations role is ideal. We equally welcome fresh graduates and students who have worked in these fields already, through internships, part-time or project work, or a first job, so tell us what you have actually done and built. → A real networking foundation. You understand how a network works, TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls, VPN, and can reason about why one is misbehaving. Hands-on with MikroTik or Aruba is a bonus, not a must. → Some systems grounding. Comfortable around Microsoft 365 or Windows Server, enough to build on. If you have touched PowerShell or a bit of cloud, even better. → A security-minded way of working. You keep things safe by habit. Depth here grows on the job. → Troubleshooting instinct: you isolate a problem methodically instead of guessing, and you document what you did. → Driven, curious, adaptable: you want to know how things work and go find out, and you stay steady when priorities and topics shift. To us this matters as much as any item on the list above. → Polish and English, and able to work on site in Szczecin. Probably not a fit if... →you want to work purely in the cloud, this role is hands-on with real infrastructure, networks and hardware →you want fully remote, the infrastructure and the team you support are on site in Szczecin →you want to stay in one narrow lane, here you move between networking, systems and support as the day needs →you would rather reboot it again than find the cause, here the same fault twice is a problem to solve Nice to have: a certification such as MikroTik MTCNA, CCNA or Microsoft AZ-800 exposure to Intune, cloud or automation tools a real interest in AI you already play around with What We Offer A competitive salary of 9.000 - 12.000 PLN gross/month , stated up front, plus a benefits package that includes: → Real breadth — you own networks, systems and support across our global sites, not one narrow queue → International exposure — globally distributed teams, with colleagues at our sites in Germany, Latvia, the USA and Vietnam → Latest tooling — including the internal AI tools we build in-house → Local benefits — health coverage, paid leave & local perks How We Hire 1 Apply, two minutes. Your CV is enough to start, no cover letter needed. 2 Call with recruiting. A first conversation about the role, the setup, and the salary range, openly, before you invest more time. 3 Interview with the Head of IT infrastructure. A conversation with the hiring manager about how you think, how you work, and the technical side of the role. 4 A quick call with our team. If that goes well, a short conversation with the people you would be working with day to day. Ready to keep it all running? Send your CV. No cover letter needed. If your foundation and drive fit, we will talk within a few days. The Customization Group Columbus Cologne Leipzig Berlin Munich Szczecin Riga Dubai Saigon thecustomizationgroup.com We welcome applications from all backgrounds. What matters is your foundation and your willingness to learn.

review_candidates.title: IT Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Summary Statement: The IT Network Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the organization's enterprise and manufacturing network infrastructure at the Goodyear, AZ facility. This role serves as the primary technical owner for LAN/WAN, wireless, firewall, and IT/OT network segmentation, ensuring secure, reliable, and highly available connectivity across corporate and plant floor environments. The ideal candidate will possess strong hands-on experience with enterprise switching and routing, firewall administration, VLAN design, network security, and manufacturing (IT/OT) network architecture. Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities: Design, configure, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure, including core and access switches, routers, and firewalls, across the Goodyear facility. Implement and manage VLAN segmentation, trunking, and inter-VLAN routing to support both corporate IT and manufacturing OT (MES, AGV) network requirements. Design and maintain network segmentation between IT and OT (Manufacturing, MES, and AGV) environments to ensure security, isolation, and operational reliability. Configure and support high-availability network architecture, including HA firewall pairs, redundant core switching (MLAG/VRRP), and failover testing. Support and maintain site-to-site VPN connectivity between U.S. manufacturing facilities and the India headquarters, ensuring secure and reliable communication. Administer firewall policies, access control lists, 2FA/MFA hardening, and security configurations on perimeter and internal firewalls. Evaluate, deploy, and maintain point-to-point (P2P) wireless bridge links for inter-building and inter-facility connectivity. Monitor network performance, availability, and capacity using network monitoring tools; proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues. Troubleshoot complex connectivity, latency, and performance issues across switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless network infrastructure. Maintain accurate network documentation, including IP address schemas, VLAN assignments, switch/port mapping, network diagrams, and firewall rule sets. Coordinate with vendors and contractors on structured cabling, patch panel labeling, network cabinet cleanup, and infrastructure installation projects. Collaborate with the Cybersecurity team on VAPT findings, network-related remediation efforts, and ongoing security compliance. Support the network aspects of IT infrastructure projects, plant buildouts, system migrations, and equipment cutovers. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards, network security policies, and infrastructure best practices. Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior network engineers and IT staff. Participate in after-hours maintenance windows and on-call support as required. Perform other duties as assigned. Minimum Requirements and Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in network engineering or enterprise network administration. Strong hands-on experience with enterprise switches, routers, and firewalls (e.g., Cisco, HP/Aruba, FortiGate, or equivalent). Proficiency in VLAN design, routing protocols, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and LAN/WAN networking. Experience with firewall administration, site-to-site and remote-access VPN configuration, and network security best practices. Experience with IT/OT network segmentation in a manufacturing environment strongly preferred. Knowledge of network monitoring and management tools. Familiarity with structured cabling, patch panels, and network documentation standards. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Preferences: Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) or CCNP Fortinet NSE Certification Aruba/HP Certified Networking Professional CompTIA Network+ ITIL Foundation

review_candidates.description: Infrastructure Operations Engineer (Linux) — 24x7 GPU Data Centre Remote-first (with 2 days per week down the line once they open their Aztec West office) · £50,000–£65,000 depending on level (L2/L3) · 4-on-4-off shift · Permanent I'm working with an AI infrastructure company that builds and operates GPU data centres across the UK, converting legacy industrial and energy sites into modern, renewable-powered compute. They're about a year in, backed by around half a billion in investment, running modular data centres packed with Nvidia GPUs, and currently building out their second and third sites. Their compute powers a single, highly technical customer running large-scale AI workloads. This is genuinely new national infrastructure, and they're standing up the operations function that keeps it running. I'm looking for someone who joins early enough to shape how it works. What I'm looking for This isn't a first-line "watch the dashboard and escalate" seat. I need an engineer who owns and resolves. You'd be the technical owner of live GPU infrastructure performance, reliability and security. When something breaks, you diagnose it, root-cause it and fix it, rather than passing it up the chain. You'd handle genuinely technical incidents and tickets from a technical customer (no end users), coordinate maintenance and change, work closely with the build and site partners, and help design the runbooks, tooling and monitoring that a young operation is still building from scratch. Because it's early-stage, there's real autonomy, real visibility with leadership, and a direct hand in how they operate at scale as they grow. What you'd actually do Own and resolve complex incidents across GPU compute, storage, networking and the wider platform, working at the Linux command line rather than escalating first. Root-cause analysis and permanent fixes, not just symptom clearing. Build and improve monitoring, alerting and automation so the platform runs cleaner over time. Coordinate maintenance windows, changes and site work with engineering, field and Smart Hands partners. Own technical tickets end to end, keep documentation and knowledge current, and run clean shift handovers. Help set the operational standards for a function that's still being built. What you'll need Professional Linux experience. You're comfortable administering and troubleshooting Linux (RHEL or similar) at the command line in a production environment. This is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have. An infrastructure background (servers, compute, storage, virtualisation), rather than a purely network one. Automation and scripting (Ansible, Python, Bash or similar) and the instinct to build rather than just operate off-the-shelf tools. Real incident-resolution experience at 2nd or 3rd line, owning problems through to resolution under SLA. You're comfortable working a 24x7, 4-on-4-off shift pattern (12-hour days and nights). review_candidates.description: Job Title Description The Space Telescope Science Institute (STScI), operated by the Association of Universities for Research in Astronomy (AURA), is NASA's science operations center for missions including the Hubble and James Webb Space Telescopes. STScI leads observation planning, data analysis, public engagement, and data archiving for flagship missions. Our staff include experts in astronomy, engineering, education, information technology, communications, and administration who work together to advance and share discoveries from space. STScI is seeking an Enterprise Technology Lead to set the direction for enterprise information technology across the institute, drive modernization, and serve as the institute’s senior IT advisor across mission, engineering, and business functions. This position supports hybrid or fully remote work arrangements. Candidates must reside in MD, DE, VA, PA, DC, or WV. Hybrid staff are expected on-site a minimum of three days per week. U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency required; ITAR clearance required. Enterprise Technology Lead Role And Responsibilities This role is ideal for a senior information technology leader who operates at enterprise altitude while remaining willing and able to engage substantively with technical work when the situation demands it. The Enterprise Technology Lead reports to the Head of IT and co-chairs the enterprise technology governance body. The position emphasizes strategic technology direction, modernization leadership, portfolio and financial discipline, and trusted advisory engagement across the institute. This is a hands-on leadership role that blends strategy with execution, working closely with Chief Engineers, mission leadership, IT operations, and division stakeholders to ensure technology decisions are coherent, sustainable, and aligned with the institute’s long-term direction. Key Responsibilities: Enterprise Technology Strategy & Governance Co-chair the enterprise technology governance body and drive cross-functional decision-making across mission and business functions. Assist in the development and execution of a multi-year enterprise technology roadmap aligned with mission, engineering, and institutional business objectives. Own enterprise information technology architecture and integration strategy across mission systems, enterprise platforms, and shared services. Serve as trusted technology advisor to senior leaders, managers and institute staff on how technology can improve efficiency, delivery, and decision-making. Lead IT product roadmap validation, technology lifecycle governance, and technical due diligence. Cloud-First & Run-Anywhere Strategy Help set enterprise direction for a cloud-first posture spanning public cloud, private cloud, and SaaS. Lead modernization of the on-premises data center to operate as a private cloud with workload portability across environments. Govern SaaS migration strategy, infrastructure as code, cloud integration patterns, and workload placement principles. Support the Cloud Center of Excellence to balance performance, cost, and operational fit across environments. Technology Portfolio & Financial Governance Drive continuous rationalization of the enterprise technology portfolio and active decommissioning of redundant tools and systems. Establish and govern a consistent framework for evaluating technology investments, renewals, and consolidation opportunities. Build enterprise-wide financial visibility across the technology portfolio and lead TCO modeling for current and future-state environments. Partner with finance and operational stakeholders to communicate investment rationale and reduce the cost of running enterprise IT. Identity, Security & AI Governance Govern enterprise identity and access management strategy and Zero Trust posture. Align security posture to certification and regulatory standards including ITAR. Monitor and enforce enterprise AI governance policy consistent with NASA policy requirements and responsible use standards. Lead enterprise AI enablement to amplify workforce effectiveness while maintaining clear guardrails. Institutional Leadership & Advisory Serve as trusted technology advisor to institutional leadership across science, engineering, and business functions. Represent the IT division in committees, working groups, and cross-divisional forums. Lead enterprise communications for technology change management. Coordinate cross-mission systems integration across NASA and AURA centers. Drive process improvement and modernization initiatives. Your Experience, Skills & Qualifications: 7+ years in a senior technology leadership capacity at enterprise scale. Demonstrated technical depth across cloud environments, enterprise data centers, private cloud, containerization, virtualization, storage, and infrastructure as code. 5+ years leading on premises to SaaS migration programs at enterprise scale. 2+ years defining and governing enterprise IAM strategy, with demonstrated experience integrating modern identity providers alongside Active Directory. Demonstrated experience governing enterprise application portfolios. Demonstrated AI policy development and enterprise AI service introduction. Track record leading enterprise technology modernization, portfolio rationalization, or major platform transitions. Direct accountability for aligning architecture with regulatory and compliance requirements (ITAR, federal standards). Experience developing and executing multi-year enterprise technology roadmaps. Familiarity with NIST 800-53 and NIST 800-171 security control frameworks preferred. Hands-on Kubernetes experience across on-premises and cloud environments preferred. Observability and SIEM platform experience (Datadog, Splunk, or CrowdStrike) preferred. Experience operating in federal, research, or mission-driven technology environments preferred. Relevant certifications in cloud, cybersecurity, or enterprise architecture (AWS, Azure, CISSP, TOGAF, or similar) preferred. The substitution of additional relevant education and/or experience for stated qualifications may be considered. Salary range is $180,000 to $195,000. Final compensation is based on experience, skills, internal equity, and market conditions. The posted salary range represents a general guideline. STScI considers several factors when determining salary offers, including internal equity, position scope and responsibilities, candidate qualifications, experience, education, skills, and current market conditions. We believe technology has the power to address our greatest challenge, climate change, while also delivering incredible service and customer experience. We are changing the way people interact with their energy company - by making it approachable, low cost, easy-to-understand, and most importantly, 100% renewable. At Octopus Tech, you’ll have real ownership, variety, and the chance to shape products that make a tangible difference in people’s lives – lowering bills, enabling greener living, and delivering experiences customers genuinely love. You’ll work side by side with teams across marketing, operations, and data, and see the impact of your work in the real world, fast. Our Global Platform Engineering team is responsible for architecting, building, and maintaining the core infrastructure, tooling, and services that enable our engineering teams to deliver at scale safely and reliably. As a Platform Engineer within this newly created team, you’ll contribute to the design and delivery of the systems and services that form the foundation of our platforms. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers to build scalable solutions, improve automation, and support areas such as cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and developer experience. You’ll bring curiosity, problem-solving skills, and a willingness to learn new technologies, with a strong interest in building reliable and efficient infrastructure. Thriving in an environment that welcomes continuous improvement and new ideas, your communication skills and attention to detail will be indispensable as you help turn complex challenges into practical solutions that make life easier for engineering teams. If this sounds exciting, we’d love to chat. What You'll Do Contribute to building and improving platform services, writing code, reviewing changes, and supporting deployments Work alongside senior engineers to design and implement solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience Help maintain and operate core systems such as CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and monitoring Participate in incident response and retrospectives, contributing to learning and improvement Collaborate with other engineers to understand needs and translate them into practical platform solutions Take ownership of tasks and smaller projects, while developing towards owning larger areas of the platform What You'll Have Solid communication skills and a collaborative approach. Hands-on experience with AWS or another major cloud provider. Familiarity with security best practices and automation tools. Experience contributing to the operation of production systems, ideally in a distributed or cloud environment. Experience with some of the following areas, and eagerness to learn the rest: Docker and Kubernetes (we use Amazon EKS in production) Python or other scripting languages Datadog or similar monitoring/logging tools Messaging queues or event-driven systems (we use RabbitMQ) Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tools Networking basics PostgreSQL or another relational database Linux system administration basics Bonus Points If You Have Exposure to multi-team environments or shared platform services. Interest in data-focused systems such as analytics, telemetry, or IoT Familiarity with CI/CD or observability practices beyond the basics A proactive mindset and enthusiasm for learning from more senior engineers Why Else You'll Love It Here Our company culture - We are an organization where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. Fully paid medical , dental , and vision insurance for employees & their family. Paid time off — we know working hard means also being able to recharge as needed, we trust our employees to get the work done and take the time they need. We offer 20 days of paid vacation and 8 paid sick days annually. 401(k) plan with employer match Parental leave. Biological, adoptive and foster parents are all eligible. Pre-tax commuter benefits Flexible working environment - genuine work life balance here; we treat you as a human, and do our best to make work and life merge smoothly together Salary - The expected salary range for this Platform Engineer II role is between $118,000 - $151,000 annually. Your exact compensation will be determined by your technical expertise, professional experience, and how well your unique skills align with the role's specific needs. Equity Options Scheme - you own your own part of the business, share options in the whole Octopus Energy Group so we all work together towards success Your development is important - we support and help with development including internal and external courses, learning, study support etc, all bespoke to you If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you. Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone. Where necessary, we sometimes use AI tools to help with parts of our hiring process, like reviewing applications or assessing responses. We’re lucky to receive a huge amount of interest, so these tools help our recruiters manage that volume, not replace them. Ultimately, every hiring decision (for example, whether to progress your application or not) is always made by a real person in our Talent team. If you’d like to know more about how we use your data, you can reach out to us via email at talent@octoenergy.com. We’re happy to help!

We need someone who can balance technical excellence with pragmatic execution, ensuring our product evolves while meeting the demands of today’s challenges. We embrace an Agile way of working, but we know success also requires grit, ownership, and a willingness to step beyond conventional roles. Specifically, you will play a role in deploying, monitoring and supporting the infrastructure for our product line using modern software development and DevSecOps practices. There will be opportunities to learn as well as using your own experience to influence the team and platform. What You'll Be Doing... Design, implement, and maintain scalable infrastructure using AWS services (EC2, S3, Elastic IPs, Glacier, SQS, Lambda). Manage and orchestrate containers using Docker and Kubernetes Design and maintain a queue-based processing pipeline using RabbitMQ and AWS SQS for message and email queuing. Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for system health and performance. Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform Work with development teams to streamline CI/CD processes. Troubleshoot production issues, conduct root cause analyses, and ensure system reliability and uptime. Ensure secure cloud operations, managing access controls and best practices. Optimize cost, scalability, and performance of deployed resources. What You'll Be Working With… Kubernetes and Docker AWS Argo Prometheus and Grafana Terraform What We're Looking For... Collaborative Yet Assertive: You work well in teams but know when to stand your ground and advocate for the right approach. What You Can Expect From Us… Meaningful work You’ll be contributing to a critical telematics platform that supports connected vehicle solutions used by businesses globally. A standout workspace Based in our purpose-built Telematics HQ at Arden Square, Crewe, you’ll enjoy: Modern, collaborative workspaces Onsite pizzeria, café, and barista station A unique rooftop bar And yes… Star Wars themed features throughout the office! Every individual, from entry-level to the senior team, have their own personal development plans with clear routes for progression and regular reviews. Established in 1990, we're trusted by over 470,000 businesses to help them grow and become more productive. With over 3000 colleagues across 5 continents, our people are critical to our success as we develop new innovative products across a growing range of businesses. Our values... Driven - W e are ambitious and tenacious. We constantly strive for more, we look to the future, and we are already working on what’s next. Agile - We are quick to adapt to change. We stay ahead of market trends and create solutions for the future. Innovative - The status quo is there to be challenged. We are passionate about pushing boundaries and always think bigger. Inclusive - We know the value of our customers, partners, suppliers and colleagues. We encourage inclusivity and work collaboratively. We Also Offer Global Female Health Policy & Female Health Champions Pregnancy Loss and Fertility Treatment Policies Endometriosis Friendly Employer (UK) Women-focused gym & female health events Mental Health First Aiders Disability Confident Committed Employer (Level 1) Race at Work Charter signatory Proud sponsor of Crewe Pride (5 years running) and Cheshire Pride Awards Corporate Supporter 2025 Community network driving charity and volunteering initiatives, with 8 consecutive years of participation in the UK Challenge. review_candidates.title: Network Operations Specialist (m/w/d)
review_candidates.description: RIEDEL Communications ist der führende Anbieter von Live-Produktionstools in den Bereichen Medien, Sport und Unterhaltung. Um die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden ganzheitlich abzudecken, teilen wir uns in drei Geschäftsfelder auf: Product Division, Managed Technology & Riedel Networks! Unsere Division Managed Technology vermietet im Rahmen von internationalen Live-Events unsere Audio-, Video-, IT- und Kommunikationslösungen und bietet einen umfassenden Service von der Projektplanung bis hin zur Realisierung vor Ort. Dabei geht es nicht nur um Festivals, wie Rock am Ring oder Sportevents – wie die Formel1 oder den Super Bowl – sondern auch darum allen Gästen ein Gänsehaut-Erlebnis zu garantieren. Als Network Operations Specialist (m/w/d) bist du Teil unseres Remote Operations Teams und überwachst, betreibst und unterstützt unsere Netzwerk- und Kommunikationssysteme für internationale Live-Events und Broadcast-Produktionen. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team stellst du sicher, dass unsere Systeme weltweit zuverlässig funktionieren und technische Herausforderungen schnell gelöst werden. DEINE VERANTWORLICHKEITEN Du überwachst und betreibst unsere Netzwerk-, Funk- und Kommunikationssysteme für internationale Live-Events, Broadcast-Produktionen und Medienprojekte. Du betreust Veranstaltungen aus unserem Remote Operations Center (ROC) heraus und stellst einen reibungslosen technischen Betrieb sicher. Du richtest Systeme ein, führst Konfigurationsanpassungen durch und unterstützt bei der Inbetriebnahme von Netzwerk- und Kommunikationslösungen. Du analysierst technische Störungen, übernimmst das Incident Management und sorgst für eine schnelle sowie nachhaltige Fehlerbehebung. Du unterstützt unsere Event- und Produktionsteams bei der Fehlersuche, Optimierung und dem Betrieb von Netzwerk- und Kommunikationsdiensten im produktiven Umfeld. Du dokumentierst Vorfälle, Betriebsabläufe und technische Änderungen und trägst zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Prozesse bei. Du arbeitest eng mit internen Fachbereichen zusammen und unterstützt bei der Umsetzung innovativer Lösungen für Broadcast-, Medien- und Eventtechnologien. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation im Bereich IT, Netzwerktechnik, Kommunikationstechnik oder Veranstaltungstechnik Erste bis mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb technischer Systeme, idealerweise in den Bereichen Netzwerk-, Broadcast-, Event- oder Kommunikationstechnik Gute Kenntnisse von Netzwerkgrundlagen wie LAN, WAN, VPN, TCP/IP und VLAN-Technologien Bereitschaft zu Schicht-, Wochenend- und Nachteinsätzen im Rahmen internationaler Live-Produktionen Begeisterung für Funk-, Intercom-, Audio-, Netzwerk- und Kommunikationssysteme Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an der Störungsanalyse unter Zeitdruck Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Erfahrung mit Monitoring- und Management-Tools wie Zabbix, Jira oder Confluence sind wünschenswert WIR BIETEN Mehr als nur Gehalt – dein Plus bei RIEDEL Freu dich auf 30 Tage Urlaub und viele zusätzliche Angebote – vom JobRad über exklusive Mitarbeiterrabatte, Corporate Benefits bis hin zu unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge. Außerdem wartet unser globales Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprogramm auf dich. Flexibilität, die zu deinem Leben passt Ob Frühaufsteher*in oder Nachteule – unser flexibles Arbeitszeitsystem und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten im hybriden Modell sorgen für echte Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben. Karriere mit Perspektive Wir fördern dein Potenzial mit zahlreichen individuellen Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten – für deinen ganz persönlichen Karriere-Boost. Unterstützung in jeder Lebenslage "meinEAP" bietet dir hilfreiche Services – z. B. bei der Kinderbetreuung, der Pflege von Angehörigen oder für dein körperliches und seelisches Wohlbefinden. Energie tanken – vom Kaffee bis zum Mittagessen Ein echter Genuss: Unsere eigene Kaffeeröstung – kostenlos an der hauseigenen Kaffeebar, ganz nach deinem Geschmack. Für das leibliche Wohl sorgt zudem unsere betriebseigene Kantine mit täglich frisch zubereiteten, abwechslungsreichen Gerichten zu fairen Preisen – ausgewogen, schmackhaft und direkt vor Ort. BEREICHERE UNSER TEAM! Bei uns erwartet dich eine aufregende Herausforderung mit jeder Menge Möglichkeiten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. RIEDEL steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt! Wir freuen uns, dich so wie du bist, kennenzulernen - fernab von irgendwelchem Schubladendenken.

review_candidates.title: IT Access Administrator
review_candidates.description: This position is based at our Corporate Headquarters in Oak Ridge, TN (221 S. Rutgers Avenue). The IT Access Administrator supports the monitoring of application access, assists with the implementation and maintenance of system tools, and helps maintain IT-related policies and procedures to ensure accuracy and mitigate risk for ORNL Federal Credit Union. This position assists with IT communication within the organization and across IT teams to help ensure clarity, alignment, and timely updates on incidents, initiatives, policies, and system changes. Essential Functions & Responsibilities : Performs access account administration tasks for business lines, external partners, senior management, and internal customers, including privilege requests and password management, in alignment with Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Privileged Access Management (PAM) principles. Duties include applying least privilege, supporting identity lifecycle activities (onboarding, role changes, and offboarding), and following secure credential handling practices for privileged accounts. Assists project teams by helping verify that access entitlement controls, segregation of duties, and compliance requirements are implemented and maintained. Supports the deployment, configuration, and optimization of IAM and PAM tools, participates in periodic and ongoing access reviews, and helps ensure adherence to regulatory and security standards. Supports IT communication within the organization, with external entities, and across IT teams to promote clarity, alignment, and timely updates. Assists in delivering accurate and consistent messaging during incidents to help minimize business impact, communicating planned system changes and maintenance windows, and sharing updates on IT policies and procedures. Acts as a liaison for IT projects as assigned by providing progress updates and basic impact information, and helps foster collaboration among IT teams through regular updates and documentation. During crisis or recovery events, assists in providing prompt and transparent communication of escalation protocols and recovery status to stakeholders. Maintains a department-level project list and coordinates with vendors, equipment, and supplies as directed. Helps develop schedules for system testing activities and coordinates participation and attendance with key stakeholders. Works within the ticketing systems to ensure tickets are addressed in a timely manner. Performs operational tasks for certificate and token management and provides timely and clear communications to stakeholders related to technical changes, projects, and system testing. Develops and/or maintains written procedures and “How to” documentation to support access management functions and application access administration. Maintains and updates the Staff List, Role Templates, and Policy Templates, coordinating with appropriate business lines for annual reviews. Supports periodic entitlement revalidations to confirm that staff have appropriate access and entitlements. Maintains metrics for access management that align with organizational objectives. Creates and updates dashboards to support access management functions and analyzes system and database logs to help identify and resolve potential or existing issues. Proactively identifies and reports process gaps and assists in remediation efforts. Participates in IT’s Change Advisory Board (CAB) activities as assigned, coordinating with vendors, stakeholders, and schedules in alignment with approved change windows. Reviews proposed access-related and organizationally impactful changes and prepares or delivers timely communication if warranted. Performs other job-related duties as assigned. Networks, systems, and whatever the day brings. Szczecin Full-time 9.000 - 12.000 PLN gross/month Start: asap Do you like variety, and do you go and figure things out rather than wait to be told? We are looking for a System Administrator to support our infrastructure and our people across the group, from our Szczecin site. One hour it is a switch config, the next a request from a colleague three time zones away. About TCG In 2004, our founders flew to China for the Canton Fair. No plan B, no investors. The Customization Group is now a global leader in mass customization and print-on-demand e-commerce, manufacturing personalised products in Germany, Poland, the USA and Latvia and selling through 20+ own shops and 1,000+ partner stores. 750+ people, 40+ nationalities. The Role The job is global: you help keep our on-premise infrastructure running for colleagues across our locations. Two things sit at the heart of it, networking and systems administration , and you move between them and everything around them rather than owning one narrow lane. Some days that is the network, some days it is Microsoft 365 or a Windows Server, some days it is a colleague who needs a hand. It is broad, hands-on, and rarely the same two days running. You do not need to know all of it on day one; you need the foundation and the drive to grow into the rest, which is exactly how the person before you did it. This is an on-site role: the hardware and the team are here in Szczecin, so it is not remote or hybrid. In short: Networking and systems administration, on-premise first, supporting a global team from Szczecin. Broad, hands-on, and rarely the same two days running. What You Will Do → Look after the network. Our multi-site setup runs on MikroTik and HPE/Aruba, with VLANs and VPN tying the locations together. You keep it healthy and help it grow. → Administer our systems. Microsoft 365 (Entra ID, Exchange, Intune) and on-prem Windows Server, plus the accounts, devices and access that colleagues rely on every day. → Support people across our sites. Be the person colleagues can bring a problem to, wherever they sit, and sort out the office networks and hardware they depend on. → Troubleshoot to the root cause. When something breaks, find why, fix it, and write it down so it does not come back. Keeping things secure is part of the job throughout. → Make things easier with automation. We are an AI-first company that builds its own internal tools, so there is real room to automate the repetitive work, wiring up AI-driven workflows and connectors with tools like Zapier, n8n and MCP. A genuine plus, not a day-one must. Who We're Looking For Sounds like you? → 2+ years in a systems administration, network administration, IT support or network operations role is ideal. We equally welcome fresh graduates and students who have worked in these fields already, through internships, part-time or project work, or a first job, so tell us what you have actually done and built. → A real networking foundation. You understand how a network works, TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls, VPN, and can reason about why one is misbehaving. Hands-on with MikroTik or Aruba is a bonus, not a must. → Some systems grounding. Comfortable around Microsoft 365 or Windows Server, enough to build on. If you have touched PowerShell or a bit of cloud, even better. → A security-minded way of working. You keep things safe by habit. Depth here grows on the job. → Troubleshooting instinct: you isolate a problem methodically instead of guessing, and you document what you did. → Driven, curious, adaptable: you want to know how things work and go find out, and you stay steady when priorities and topics shift. To us this matters as much as any item on the list above. → Polish and English, and able to work on site in Szczecin. Probably not a fit if... →you want to work purely in the cloud, this role is hands-on with real infrastructure, networks and hardware →you want fully remote, the infrastructure and the team you support are on site in Szczecin →you want to stay in one narrow lane, here you move between networking, systems and support as the day needs →you would rather reboot it again than find the cause, here the same fault twice is a problem to solve Nice to have: a certification such as MikroTik MTCNA, CCNA or Microsoft AZ-800 exposure to Intune, cloud or automation tools a real interest in AI you already play around with What We Offer A competitive salary of 9.000 - 12.000 PLN gross/month , stated up front, plus a benefits package that includes: → Real breadth — you own networks, systems and support across our global sites, not one narrow queue → International exposure — globally distributed teams, with colleagues at our sites in Germany, Latvia, the USA and Vietnam → Latest tooling — including the internal AI tools we build in-house → Local benefits — health coverage, paid leave & local perks How We Hire 1 Apply, two minutes. Your CV is enough to start, no cover letter needed. 2 Call with recruiting. A first conversation about the role, the setup, and the salary range, openly, before you invest more time. 3 Interview with the Head of IT infrastructure. A conversation with the hiring manager about how you think, how you work, and the technical side of the role. 4 A quick call with our team. If that goes well, a short conversation with the people you would be working with day to day. Ready to keep it all running? Send your CV. No cover letter needed. If your foundation and drive fit, we will talk within a few days. The Customization Group Columbus Cologne Leipzig Berlin Munich Szczecin Riga Dubai Saigon thecustomizationgroup.com We welcome applications from all backgrounds. What matters is your foundation and your willingness to learn.

Role Summary The IT Operations Specialist is an experienced individual contributor role responsible for proactively managing all facility requests, IT support tickets, and escalations while continuously improving service levels and driving operational excellence. This role owns the day-to-day reliability of IT operations and facilities support, ensuring issues are anticipated, resolved efficiently, and prevented through strong systems, processes, and automation. Partner with Facilities and vendors on installs, upgrades, and infrastructure improvements. Act as an escalation point and mentor within the IT Operations function. Implement and maintain system configurations, policies, and integrations. Partner with Security to ensure systems align with security standards and compliance requirements. Support and enforce security controls related to access management, device compliance, and operational security. Escalate and assist in investigation of potential security incidents. Familiarity with compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001). new_matches.title: Infrastructure operations Engineer
new_matches.description: Infrastructure Operations Engineer (Linux) — 24x7 GPU Data Centre Remote-first (with 2 days per week down the line once they open their Aztec West office) · £50,000–£65,000 depending on level (L2/L3) · 4-on-4-off shift · Permanent I'm working with an AI infrastructure company that builds and operates GPU data centres across the UK, converting legacy industrial and energy sites into modern, renewable-powered compute. They're about a year in, backed by around half a billion in investment, running modular data centres packed with Nvidia GPUs, and currently building out their second and third sites. Their compute powers a single, highly technical customer running large-scale AI workloads. This is genuinely new national infrastructure, and they're standing up the operations function that keeps it running. I'm looking for someone who joins early enough to shape how it works. What I'm looking for This isn't a first-line "watch the dashboard and escalate" seat. I need an engineer who owns and resolves. You'd be the technical owner of live GPU infrastructure performance, reliability and security. When something breaks, you diagnose it, root-cause it and fix it, rather than passing it up the chain. You'd handle genuinely technical incidents and tickets from a technical customer (no end users), coordinate maintenance and change, work closely with the build and site partners, and help design the runbooks, tooling and monitoring that a young operation is still building from scratch. Because it's early-stage, there's real autonomy, real visibility with leadership, and a direct hand in how they operate at scale as they grow. What you'd actually do Own and resolve complex incidents across GPU compute, storage, networking and the wider platform, working at the Linux command line rather than escalating first. Root-cause analysis and permanent fixes, not just symptom clearing. Build and improve monitoring, alerting and automation so the platform runs cleaner over time. Coordinate maintenance windows, changes and site work with engineering, field and Smart Hands partners. Own technical tickets end to end, keep documentation and knowledge current, and run clean shift handovers. Help set the operational standards for a function that's still being built. What you'll need Professional Linux experience. You're comfortable administering and troubleshooting Linux (RHEL or similar) at the command line in a production environment. This is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have. An infrastructure background (servers, compute, storage, virtualisation), rather than a purely network one. Automation and scripting (Ansible, Python, Bash or similar) and the instinct to build rather than just operate off-the-shelf tools. Real incident-resolution experience at 2nd or 3rd line, owning problems through to resolution under SLA. You're comfortable working a 24x7, 4-on-4-off shift pattern (12-hour days and nights). Eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC), which will be needed within the first year, and a full UK driving licence . Located within reach of Bristol for the occasional office day. Nice to have GPU, HPC or AI infrastructure exposure; monitoring stacks (Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, Nagios, SolarWinds); Kubernetes, Terraform or IaC; ITIL awareness; cloud, hosting, data centre or MSP operations. The shift pattern, honestly It's a genuine 24x7 shift role including nights, but the 4-on-4-off pattern is predictable and gives you large blocks of time off, effectively around half the month. You'll know your schedule well in advance rather than being permanently on call. Why I think it's worth a look Cutting-edge Nvidia GPU infrastructure at real scale, a well-funded company building critical national infrastructure, genuine autonomy to shape how operations run, and the chance to grow with a business that's scaling fast. If you want to own and build rather than just monitor, this is the one. If that sounds like you, get in touch and I'll tell you more.

new_matches.description: Job Title Description The Space Telescope Science Institute (STScI), operated by the Association of Universities for Research in Astronomy (AURA), is NASA's science operations center for missions including the Hubble and James Webb Space Telescopes. STScI leads observation planning, data analysis, public engagement, and data archiving for flagship missions. Our staff include experts in astronomy, engineering, education, information technology, communications, and administration who work together to advance and share discoveries from space. STScI is seeking an Enterprise Technology Lead to set the direction for enterprise information technology across the institute, drive modernization, and serve as the institute’s senior IT advisor across mission, engineering, and business functions. This position supports hybrid or fully remote work arrangements. Candidates must reside in MD, DE, VA, PA, DC, or WV. Hybrid staff are expected on-site a minimum of three days per week. U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency required; ITAR clearance required. Enterprise Technology Lead Role And Responsibilities This role is ideal for a senior information technology leader who operates at enterprise altitude while remaining willing and able to engage substantively with technical work when the situation demands it. The Enterprise Technology Lead reports to the Head of IT and co-chairs the enterprise technology governance body. The position emphasizes strategic technology direction, modernization leadership, portfolio and financial discipline, and trusted advisory engagement across the institute. This is a hands-on leadership role that blends strategy with execution, working closely with Chief Engineers, mission leadership, IT operations, and division stakeholders to ensure technology decisions are coherent, sustainable, and aligned with the institute’s long-term direction. Key Responsibilities: Enterprise Technology Strategy & Governance Co-chair the enterprise technology governance body and drive cross-functional decision-making across mission and business functions. Assist in the development and execution of a multi-year enterprise technology roadmap aligned with mission, engineering, and institutional business objectives. Own enterprise information technology architecture and integration strategy across mission systems, enterprise platforms, and shared services. Serve as trusted technology advisor to senior leaders, managers and institute staff on how technology can improve efficiency, delivery, and decision-making. Lead IT product roadmap validation, technology lifecycle governance, and technical due diligence. With regional subsidiaries in the UAE and India and projects completed in 11 countries, UGCE combines global reach with local insight to provide tailored engineering solutions. The company’s success is driven by strong technical expertise, high-quality service delivery, and long-term partnerships with clients who rely on UGCE to realize their projects. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Structural Design Engineer role based in Alexandria, Egypt. The Structural Design Engineer will perform structural analysis and design for buildings and infrastructure projects, ensuring safety, code compliance, and cost-effectiveness. Daily responsibilities include developing structural models, preparing design calculations, creating detailed drawings and specifications, and coordinating with civil, architectural, and MEP teams. Support legal team and external collection agencies in their efforts to collect outstanding amounts.
